required: 🔒 Join our channels first To use Aegis, please join:
missing_alert: You haven't joined all the channels yet ({n} left).
owner_warn: ⚠️ Forced join: membership in {title} can't be checked ({error}). Make Aegis an admin there. Until then this channel is skipped, so nobody gets locked out.
admin_warn: ⚠️ Aegis is not an admin in {n} channel(s) marked ⚠️. Membership can't be checked there, so they are skipped until you make the bot an admin.
admin_hint: ⬆️⬇️ change the order users see · 🗑 remove (asks first).
add_prompt: ➕ Add a channel Send one of: • its username: @channel • its link: https://t.me/channel • its numeric id: -100… • or forward any post from the channel. Make Aegis an admin there first, otherwise membership can't be checked.
add_bad_input: ❓ That isn't a channel. Send @username, a t.me link, a -100… id, or forward a post from the channel.
add_not_found: ❌ Telegram can't find that chat ({error}). Check the username, or make Aegis an admin there first.
add_bad_type: ❌ Only channels and public groups can be forced-join targets.
add_exists: ℹ️ {title} is already in the list.
add_need_link: ❌ {title} is private and has no invite link Aegis can use. Make Aegis an admin there (with the right to invite users) and try again.
added_not_admin: ✅ {title} added, but ⚠️ Aegis is not an admin there: it is skipped until you make the bot an admin.
turned_off: ⏸ Forced join is OFF: nobody is asked to join.
gone: ℹ️ That channel is no longer in the list.
